qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Dominant Nordic corporate pension franchise in Norway and Sweden (SPP). Long-term occupational pension schemes have high administrative switching costs and sticky employer customer bases, enabling disciplined fee capture as capital shifts to unit-linked products.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 5, REJECT). Regional Nordic occupational pension provider facing demographic aging, public pension reforms, and guaranteed legacy book duration limits, capping predictable competitive advantage period well below 15 years.
qualitative.evidence: Storebrand delivers sticky occupational pension flows in Norway and Sweden (SPP), with recent ROE improving toward 11-18% via growth in capital-light unit-linked savings and insurance. However, runway is geographically capped in the Nordics, and secular demographic aging combined with regulatory pension framework changes restricts the durable competitive advantage period to 5 years.
